rss.description: Application resident memory sampled from the native process monitor, in bytes

phase.description: Performance baseline phase associated with this sample, e.g. ready or stable

duration.description: Elapsed time for the measured application phase in milliseconds, when applicable

model.description: Monaco opening model elapsed monotonic time in milliseconds.

attach.description: Monaco opening attach elapsed monotonic time in milliseconds.

settled.description: Monaco opening settled elapsed monotonic time in milliseconds.

first_frame.description: Monaco opening first_frame elapsed monotonic time in milliseconds.

max_frame_gap.description: Monaco opening max_frame_gap elapsed monotonic time in milliseconds.

frames.description: Monaco opening frames count reported by the editor measurement.

lines.description: Monaco opening lines count reported by the editor measurement.

utf16_length.description: Monaco opening utf16_length count reported by the editor measurement.

reused.description: Whether opening reused the existing Monaco document model.

events.message: Editor semantic update measured with {tokens} tokens

tokens.description: Number of semantic tokens delivered to the editor for this update

revision.description: Document revision associated with the semantic token update, when supplied

operation.description: Git service operation served from the history cache, e.g. history

duration.description: Elapsed history cache lookup time in milliseconds

operation.description: Git service operation that issued the measured command

duration.description: Elapsed Git command workflow time in milliseconds

succeeded.description: Whether the Git command result reported success

operation.description: Git service read operation being measured, e.g. history

duration.description: Elapsed Git service read time in milliseconds

succeeded.description: Whether the Git service read returned a result

phase.description: Worktree inspection phase supplied by the Git service

duration.description: Elapsed time for this worktree inspection phase, in milliseconds

worktree.description: Worktree root path from the Git snapshot, redacted by Core before persistence.

name.description: Controlled native signpost name for the measured operation.

duration.description: Monotonic duration of the native signpost operation.

phase.description: Native settings latency phase value; timestamps use monotonic nanoseconds.

category.description: Native settings latency category value; timestamps use monotonic nanoseconds.

event_id.description: Native settings latency event_id value; timestamps use monotonic nanoseconds.

time_ns.description: Native settings latency time_ns value; timestamps use monotonic nanoseconds.

input_ns.description: Native settings latency input_ns value; timestamps use monotonic nanoseconds.

received_ns.description: Native settings latency received_ns value; timestamps use monotonic nanoseconds.

selected_ns.description: Native settings latency selected_ns value; timestamps use monotonic nanoseconds.
